items.quote: Servi Morova led engagement with industry stakeholders across the department.
They led an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations across the department.
They spearheaded the policy review on housing grants at the national level.
Servi took ownership of emergency coordination during the flood response and steered it to completion.
They drove the reduction of waiting times at the licensing counter for the whole division.
They took ownership of cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce and steered it to completion.
They drove adoption of new technology tools for case officers for the whole division.
They was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of customer feedback improvements at service centres.
Servi Morova took ownership of evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes and steered it to completion.
They led coaching and mentoring junior officers across the department.
Servi set the direction for media interviews and press conferences across the public service.
